headline: Bruins steal a wild overtime thriller in Winnipeg as Sunday looms
morning_brew: What a hell of a night up in Winnipeg. The Bruins came out swinging and managed to scrape together a hard-fought four to three overtime victory against the Jets. It wasn't always pretty, and watching that lead evaporate in the second period had me pacing the living room like a man possessed, but finding a way to bank two points on the road is exactly what you want to see this early in the year.

JJ Peterka was the hero of the hour with that overtime winner, and honestly, seeing Elias Lindholm tie it up late in regulation reminded me of the grit we need if we are gonna make any noise this season. Jeremy Swayman stood on his head when he had to, racking up thirty saves and keeping us in it when the ice was tilting against us. I am not saying it is a perfect start, but two wins in two games is a damn good foundation to build on.

Now we keep the road trip rolling out to Minnesota for a Saturday night tilt against the Wild. First puck drop is at eight, and I will be glued to the screen to see if this group can keep the momentum going. Meanwhile, I am trying not to think about Sunday's matchup in Buffalo, but losing Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore to injuries is a tough pill to swallow before we even step on the field. It is a long season, and for now, I am just happy to enjoy this overtime win.

news_digest.headline: Shoulder injuries sideline Gonzalez, Barmore as Pats ready for Bills
news_digest.dans_take: Losing our top guys on D right before a Bills game is like losing your wallet on the Pike, just an absolute disaster.
